_meta.author: OpenAI ChatGPT for Peter Higgins
_meta.purpose: Registry of universal and conditional extended tests to maximize information extraction from every DUT. The universal panel should run on every DUT. Conditional panels should auto-enable when data type and structure support them.

registry_policy.default_rule: Always run the universal panel on every DUT.
registry_policy.conditional_rule: Auto-enable conditional tests when the DUT satisfies the required data structure, ordering, dimensionality, or event conditions.
registry_policy.instrument_position: EITT remains the primary instrument. Extended tests increase extraction, interpretation, trust, and boundary visibility without replacing the core signal.

priority_scale.High: Should be added to the standalone instrument as core extended testing.
priority_scale.Medium: Strong addition when supported by the DUT and workflow.
priority_scale.Lower: Useful but not required in the first standalone release.

requires: At least one meaningful subcomposition family
computes: EITT outputs on each meaningful subcomposition
Coherence agreement or divergence across subcompositions
extended_tests.information_gain: Shows whether the finding is robust across the composition or carried by one hidden part combination.
extended_tests.best_precedent: EXP-01 gap analysis and CoDa compliance hardening

requires: Alternate valid unit scales or equivalent normalizations
computes: EITT outputs under alternate valid scales
extended_tests.information_gain: Separates physical signal from unit-choice artifact.

requires: At least two valid carrier-to-composition mappings
computes: Delta, velocity, and lock-range shifts across mappings
extended_tests.information_gain: Measures how much of the result is decomposition choice versus system structure.
extended_tests.best_precedent: EXP-01 mapping-sensitivity gap and DUT character-analysis logic

requires: Either entropy or CLR-based structural outputs
extended_tests.information_gain: Reveals which carriers actually drive the reading instead of hiding everything in a single scalar.

requires: Relative EITT curve across multiple M values
extended_tests.information_gain: Adds lock behavior, drift structure, and degradation shape beyond simple pass/fail.

requires: Thresholded relative EITT values across tested M
extended_tests.information_gain: Separates passed scale, tested scale, and power limit instead of collapsing them into one ambiguous number.
Distinguishes small deviations from measurable deviations and prevents false confidence.
extended_tests.best_precedent: EXP-01 operating-envelope and EMBER pretest work

extended_tests.information_gain: Shows whether the system is steadily drifting, stable, or only fluctuating locally.
Provides full structural context around the EITT reading so invariance is not interpreted in isolation.

requires: At least two valid computational paths to the same key result
extended_tests.information_gain: Detects hidden propagation, implementation dependence, or accidental accumulation.
Forces every DUT into an honest, comparable reporting frame.

requires: Ability to compare original and shuffled order
extended_tests.information_gain: Shows whether the reading depends on true temporal/parametric order or only on structural support.
Extracts stationary relations and hidden mini-systems inside the full composition.

computes: Alignment of zero crossings with EITT deviations
extended_tests.information_gain: Identifies structural event points and local singularities that ordinary summaries can miss.

requires: One or more carriers behaving as quasi-constant drivers
extended_tests.information_gain: Separates driver-response systems from fully redistributing systems.

requires: Two valid decompositions of the same physical event or system
extended_tests.information_gain: Shows whether one physical event generates simultaneous information-space events on multiple simplices.
Adds directional information flow and asymmetry beyond spread and invariance.
Distinguishes persistent memory from novelty events and structural resets.

requires: Plausible alternate anchors or natural equilibrium candidates
extended_tests.information_gain: Finds whether the system has a privileged natural anchor rather than a generic one.
Turns the instrument into a classifier / thermometer for large real-domain families.

requires: Ability to generate contamination or correction variants
extended_tests.information_gain: Shows whether apparent improvement is valid or is actually contamination.
extended_tests.best_precedent: HIVP correction-as-contamination and F17 attack detection

recommended_standalone_behavior.goal: Maximum information extraction from every DUT without requiring the user to remember supplemental tests that the instrument can already provide.
